purpose: Procurement package checklist for EPC capital projects. Each package requires a full lifecycle: MR -> TBE -> PO -> VDR -> Stage Inspection -> FAT -> Expediting -> Packing -> Logistics -> Site Receipt.

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: ASME U-stamp certified, 3+ similar reactor references, ISO 9001:2015
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: raw material MPI, fit-up, root/layers, PWHT, hydrotest, final dimension check
packages.acceptance_tests: Hydrostatic test at 1.5x design pressure, pneumatic optional per code

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: ASME U-stamp + National Board certified, experience with similar column L/D ratio and tray type
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: plate verification, cylindrical shell fit-up, longitudinal/circumferential weld NDT, tray ring flatness, hydrotest
packages.acceptance_tests: Hydrostatic test per ASME VIII, internal tray mock-up fit test per tray vendor

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: API 617 certified, 5+ references for similar service, proven field reliability data
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: casing hydrotest, rotor balance (low-speed + high-speed), impeller NDT, mechanical run test at vendor
packages.acceptance_tests: API 617 mechanical run test (4-hour full speed), performance test per ASME PTC-10

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: API 611/612 certified, references for similar steam conditions
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: casing NDT, rotor balance, overspeed trip test, mechanical run test
packages.acceptance_tests: API 612 mechanical run test at rated speed, overspeed trip at 110%

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: ASME U-stamp, TEMA class R or C as applicable, 3+ references
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: tube sheet drilling pattern, baffle alignment, tube-to-tubesheet weld/expansion, shell NDT, hydrotest
packages.acceptance_tests: Hydrotest 1.5x design pressure on shell side and tube side independently

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: API 610 or ISO 13709 for OH/BB pumps, 5+ references for similar process service
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: casing hydrotest, impeller dynamic balance, mechanical run test, performance test witness
packages.acceptance_tests: Performance test per API 610: head, capacity, efficiency, NPSH at rated and turndown points

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Licensed design per API 560, experience with similar duty and fuel type
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: coil tube NDT (RT/PMI), weld NDT, coil hydrotest, refractory installation inspection, burner light-off test
packages.acceptance_tests: Shop hydrotest of coil assembly, burner flame pattern test per specification

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: API 618 certified, references for similar gas composition and pressure
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: cylinder hydrotest, frame/crankshaft NDT, running gear clearance, mechanical run test
packages.acceptance_tests: API 618 mechanical run test at rated speed, pulsation suppression verified

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: ASME U-stamp, similar vessel experience
packages.inspection_requirements: Shell fit-up and weld NDT, nozzle reinforcement, hydrotest, internal surface prep
packages.acceptance_tests: Hydrostatic test at 1.5x design pressure

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: API 650 / 620 certified fabricator, tank construction experience
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: bottom plate weld vacuum test, shell plate fit-up/NDT, roof weld, hydrostatic test per API 650
packages.acceptance_tests: API 650 acceptance: hydrostatic test full height, roof floating test (if FR), vacuum box test for bottom

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IBR / ASME S-stamp, proven experience for similar capacity/fuel
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: tube NDT, drum weld NDT, boiler hydrotest, refractory installation, burner light-off
packages.acceptance_tests: Hydraulic test per code, boiler efficiency test, emission compliance test

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: CTI (Cooling Technology Institute) certified, references for similar thermal duty
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: basin water-tightness, fill material inspection, fan assembly and balance, water distribution test
packages.acceptance_tests: CTI STD-201 performance test: approach to wet bulb, range, water flow, fan power

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 61508 / 61511 certified for SIS, proven DCS platform with > 5 references in similar process industry
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: cabinet assembly, wiring check, IO module test, integration test (FAT), hardware SAT mockup
packages.acceptance_tests: Factory Acceptance Test (FAT): IO mapping, logic simulation, alarm/ trip testing, HMI display verification, failover testing

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 62271 certified, type-tested panels, references for similar voltage class
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: busbar NDT, panel assembly, wiring check, high-pot test, primary/secondary injection test
packages.acceptance_tests: IEC 62271-200 routine tests: dielectric, main circuit resistance, mechanical operation, control/auxiliary circuit tests

packages.package_name: LV / MCC Panels (440V motor control centres)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IS/IEC 61439 certified, references for similar industrial MCC
packages.inspection_requirements: Visual check, mechanical operation of all cubicles, wiring continuity, high-pot test, protection relay test
documentation_required: MCC busbar temperature rise test report
packages.acceptance_tests: IS/IEC 61439 routine and type tests, temperature rise test for main busbar

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 62040 certified, references for similar capacity and autonomy time
technical_documents_required: Battery bank layout and rack design
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: cabinet assembly, battery cell capacity test, UPS inverter / rectifier test, load bank test
packages.acceptance_tests: Load bank test at 100% rated load for 30 min, battery autonomy test per spec, transfer test (static bypass + manual bypass)

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 60076 / IS 2026 certified, references for similar MVA rating
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: core/coil assembly, insulation resistance, turns ratio, winding resistance, power factor, impulse test, oil dielectric
packages.acceptance_tests: IEC 60076 routine tests: winding resistance, voltage ratio, short-circuit impedance, load loss, no-load loss, induced voltage, DS, PD, impulse if specified

packages.package_name: Process Analyzers (online GC, IR, O2, pH, density)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven experience in similar process media, sample conditioning system expertise
technical_documents_required: Analyzer GA and sample flow diagram
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: analyzer bench test, sample conditioning test, calibration validation, integration test with DCS simulation
packages.acceptance_tests: FAT: calibration linearity, repeatability, response time, drift, sample conditioning performance

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 60534 / API 6D certified, references for similar pressure class and media
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: body casting NDT, seat leakage test, actuator stroke test, positioner calibration, hydrostatic / closure test
packages.acceptance_tests: API 598 shell test at 1.5x rating, seat leakage test per class (Class IV/VI per FCI 70-2), actuator full stroke cycle test

packages.package_name: Pipe / Fittings / Flanges (bulk material from MTO)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Approved pipe mill per project AVL, material certs to relevant ASTM/ASME specs
technical_documents_required: Pipe MTO / BOQ (sizes, schedules, material grades)
packages.inspection_requirements: Mill test certificate (MTC) review, dimensional check per batch, PMI on alloy pipe, hydrotest cert review
packages.acceptance_tests: MTC verification + dimensional + PMI (for alloy lines), visual inspection for corrosion and marking

packages.package_name: Structural Steel (columns, beams, pipe racks, platforms)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: ISO 3834 welding certified, 3+ projects of similar steel tonnage
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: material receipt, fit-up and weld NDT (MPI/UT), surface prep and painting, dimensional check
packages.acceptance_tests: Dimensional verification per fabrication drawings, bolt torque verification on sample, coating thickness measurement

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IS/IEC 60332 / 60754 certified cable supplier, type test certificates for all cable types
technical_documents_required: Cable schedule with types and lengths
packages.inspection_requirements: Visual check of cable drums, continuity test, insulation resistance test on sample, tray fit check
packages.acceptance_tests: Continuity + insulation resistance test, flame test cert per specification

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 62271 / IEC 60076 certified, type-tested assembly, vendor with reference installations in similar process plants
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: panel fabrication, wiring, HV test, protection relay test, transformer tank and core test
packages.acceptance_tests: Full switchgear routine test per IEC 62271, transformer per IEC 60076, UPS load bank test

packages.package_name: DCS / Safety System Software and Integration
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 61508 certified functional safety engineers, experience with system version and platform
packages.inspection_requirements: FAT: IO mapping, logic simulation, alarm and trip test, HMI graphics verification, failover and redundancy test
packages.acceptance_tests: FAT + SAT: full logic simulation against cause & effect, HMI graphics walkthrough, alarm/event logging test, failover test

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven catalyst supplier with reference plant performance data, ISO certified manufacturing
technical_documents_required: Loading plan and bulk density calculation
Chemical consumption rate and storage requirements
packages.inspection_requirements: Bulk density check per drum, visual inspection, sample analysis per spec, shelf-life verification
packages.acceptance_tests: Sample analysis per purchase spec (activity, selectivity, crush strength, attrition loss)

packages.package_name: HV / LV Power Cables (bulk from route length)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IS/IEC certified cable manufacturer, type test certificates for each cable type
technical_documents_required: Cable sizing and voltage drop calculations
packages.inspection_requirements: Drum visual, conductor resistance, insulation resistance, HV test per cable type sample, sequential length check
packages.acceptance_tests: Dielectric test, conductor resistance per IEC 60228, insulation resistance test per IEC 60502

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Approved manufacturer per project AVL, material certs to ASTM A269/A312 (SS) or relevant spec
technical_documents_required: Tubing schedule (size, material, quantity per P&ID)
packages.inspection_requirements: Visual and dimensional check per lot, MTC verification, pressure test sample
packages.acceptance_tests: Visual + dimensional + MTC verification per lot

packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: IEC 60079 certified for hazardous area tracing, 3+ reference installations
packages.inspection_requirements: Visual check, insulation resistance test per circuit, continuity check, control panel assembly check
packages.acceptance_tests: Insulation resistance test after installation, circuit continuity, temperature controller calibration check

packages.package_name: Fire Protection System (pumps, hydrants, spray, foam)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: UL / FM approved for fire pumps and deluge valves, NFPA 20/13/15 compliance
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: fire pump baseplate/foundation, pump mechanical run test, deluge valve function test, spray nozzle pattern test
packages.acceptance_tests: Fire pump: NFPA 20 full performance test (flow, pressure, NPSH). Deluge/sprinkler: full flow test of each zone

packages.package_name: Material Handling / Packaged Units (conveyors, elevators, feeders)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Proven manufacturer for similar bulk material and capacity, conveyor/powder handling design expertise
packages.inspection_requirements: Stage-wise: structure fabrication, roller / idler assembly, belt splice test, drive alignment, run test
packages.acceptance_tests: No-load run test (4 hours), load run test at 80% capacity for 1 hour, belt alignment and tracking test

packages.package_name: Specialty Alloy / Clad Piping (stainless steel, duplex, hastelloy)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Approved pipe and fitting manufacturer with certified PMI capability and alloy material traceability system
technical_documents_required: Weld filler metal selection per WPS
packages.inspection_requirements: 100% PMI on all material, dimensional check, ferrite measurement (for duplex), hydrotest per pipe spec
documentation_required: PMI chemical analysis report for each lot
packages.acceptance_tests: 100% PMI verification, dimensional check per ASTM, pressure test for applicable sizes

packages.package_name: E&I Construction Consumables (cable ties, lugs, glands, markers)
packages.vendor_qualification_criteria: Approved vendor per project AVL for electrical construction consumables
packages.inspection_requirements: Visual check, sample continuity of lugs and glands, marking legibility test
packages.acceptance_tests: Sample installation test for glands and lugs on representative cable
